summary: Avalo Therapeutics filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market offering of up to $200,000,000 of common stock under an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC as sales agent, dated November 5, 2026. Shares may be sold in negotiated transactions, block trades, or Rule 415(a)(4) at-the-market methods; Jefferies receives up to 3.0% commission and sells on a commercially reasonable efforts basis with no escrow. Last reported sale price was $7.07 on November 4, 2026. No board recommendation, premium, or fixed price is stated. Watch dilution pace and any equity overhang.
